tldr: Uranus through the 10th house disrupts career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 10th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
